en: A black‑and‑white illustrated multi‑view postcard with decorative floral motifs and frames. At the top center is the caption "Helsning från Carlskrona." Surrounding this are several vignette drawings: a central cityscape with a tall clock tower standing above a rail tunnel or cutting, other civic buildings and a domed structure; a circular view of a straight street lined with ornate multistory buildings labeled "Ronnebygatan"; a triangular view of a star‑shaped fortress compound labeled "Kungsholms Fästning"; and a waterfront view of a low fortification with trees and buildings labeled "Kungsholms…". The images depict landmarks of the city of Karlskrona. There is small printer information along the left edge.
